verdict.rationale: Codegen supports event-driven automation via CI/CD triggers (docs-18) and PR review triggers on failure (docs-20), plus SDK/API for programmatic agent invocation, but there's no evidence of a general user-facing rules engine for defining arbitrary trigger-condition-action automations across events. missing for 10: a documented rules/automation builder UI, broader event types beyond CI/CD failures and PR diffs, and independent confirmation of custom trigger logic.
